title: JA Diner Joomla uses the gated step chain and unsupported variants cannot provision
steps: Run the step-chain switch and database-backed site creation tests with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing to an isolated test database.
expect: JA Boxing J6, with its AI quickstart pinned (a fake pin in the test: the shipped pins file is empty until the release gate passes), starts the step-chain frame with the owned research revision and preserves the selected quickstart in the host provision request.

Since #598 the chain is enabled by data, a pinned AI quickstart (#588), not by a template list: JA Diner J6 ships none and is refused with STEP_CHAIN_OFF, and with the shipped empty pins file no template runs the chain.
The environment master switch blocks every candidate before any site, host job or brief run is created.
Published JA Kinetic J6 remains refused with STEP_CHAIN_OFF; JA Diner WordPress remains off.
fence: A pinned AI quickstart (#588 pin, #598 chooser) plus the existing STEP_CHAIN_ENABLED master switch

tests: the contract names the chain workflow, and no template list is left
a template with a pinned AI quickstart runs the chain only while the master switch is on
a version or release prefix on the quickstart does not change the template
a template without a pinned AI quickstart, or no quickstart, never runs the chain
the shipped data: the pins file is empty, so no template runs the chain until one is pinned
the enabled ja-boxing template starts the frame with the research revision as its brief
the step chain is refused, with nothing claimed, for another account’s revision, a template not enabled or the switch off
